mil3.2.9:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say ‘a long time’, what is this thing called time?”
mil3.2.9:1.3: “Past time, Great King, future time, and present time.”
mil3.2.9:1.4: “But venerable sir, do all times exist?”
mil3.2.9:1.5: “Some times exist, Great King, and some do not exist.”
mil3.2.9:1.6: “Which exist, venerable sir, and which do not exist?”
mil3.2.9:1.7: “Whatever formations, Great King, are past, gone, ceased, and changed—that time does not exist. Whatever phenomena are results, whatever have the nature of producing results, and whatever give rebirth elsewhere—that time exists.
mil3.2.9:1.8: As for beings who have passed away and been reborn elsewhere, that time exists too.
mil3.2.9:1.9: As for beings who have passed away and not been reborn elsewhere, that time does not exist.
mil3.2.9:1.10: And for beings who have attained final extinguishment, that time does not exist either, because they have attained final extinguishment.”
